mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Carts (user_idx, product_idx, option_idx, quantity) VALUES (#{userIdx}, #{productIdx}, #{optionIdx}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_idx AS cartIdx, c.user_idx AS userIdx, c.product_idx AS productIdx, c.option_idx AS optionIdx, c.quantity, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, o.color, o.size, o.stock FROM Carts c JOIN Products p ON c.product_idx = p.product_idx JOIN ProductOption o ON c.option_idx = o.option_idx WHERE c.user_idx = #{userIdx}

SELECT c.cart_idx AS cartIdx, c.user_idx AS userIdx, c.product_idx AS productIdx, c.option_idx AS optionIdx, c.quantity, p.product_name AS productName, p.product_main_img AS productMainImg, p.price, p.discount_rate AS discountRate, o.color, o.size FROM Carts c JOIN Products p ON c.product_idx = p.product_idx JOIN ProductOption o ON c.option_idx = o.option_idx WHERE c.cart_idx = #{cartIdx}
